"Zia" means aunt or auntie. "Assunta" is an old-fashioned stereotypical southern woman's name.
In the Italian version of the American sitcom
, Sylvia Fine (née Rosenberg), the mother of Fran Fine, portrayed by actress
, is named Zia Assunta, while the grandmother is named Yetta Cacace/Concetta Caciotta.
Zi'Assunta's family name is Belpaese, her theme song is called "Moms are Tough", and she wields what seems to be a legendary whip (
). All these aspects could imply that she is the mother of the Belpaese family and a legendary hero herself.
Zi'Assunta's family name Belpaese is derived from the phrase Bel Paese, which is Italian for "beautiful country", and also refers to a semi-soft Italian cheese
Zi'Assunta shares several traits with other coffin characters. See Coffin § Traits for more details.
She and
are the only coffin characters that start with +10% Curse.
Zi'Assunta's theme used to be called "Vento Sacro" in the music selection. poncle made a poll for the official name for it and "Moms are tough" was chosen.
